title: A Magic Day on Salt Spring Island-Private tour (8 hrs)
blurb: Our tour takes us to Saltspring Island, the largest of the Southern Gulf Islands of British Columbia, on the Salish Sea. It is a beautiful Island of trees, coastline, mountains and a unique town of artists and artisans. It is home to several famous people. It has a rich history that dates back to inhabitants living on Salt Spring Island 5,000 years ago. On our tour you will enjoy spectacular scenery, exceptional food, visit to a farm for cheese tasting, and the Salt Spring Island Saturday Market, if you book this tour for a Saturday. As well, there are beautiful art galleries and distinctive stores and restaurants.
